title: Deposits, Accepted Tenders and Payment Limits on Ridgeline Installation Services Contracts
content:
This standard governs payments taken on Ridgeline Installation Services contracts: the deposit at signing, the statuses in which a payment may be taken, the tenders accepted and the ceiling on any one payment.

## Deposit at signing

The deposit due at signing is the greater of the program's minimum deposit and the program's deposit percentage of the contract price (that percentage amount rounded to the cent), never more than the contract price, less any measure fee credit applied at signing.

| Hypothetical contract | Deposit terms used | Greater of minimum and percentage | Capped at contract price | Less measure fee credit | Deposit due |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9000.00 | 33 percent, minimum 1000.00 | 2970.00 | 2970.00 | none | 2970.00 |
| 5200.00 | 50 percent, minimum 500.00 | 2600.00 | 2600.00 | 99.00 | 2501.00 |
| 800.00 | 50 percent, minimum 500.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | none | 500.00 |
| 900.00 | 50 percent, minimum 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 900.00 | none | 900.00 |

## Payment clauses retired

> A progress payment of the program's progress payment percentage of the contract price is due on the day work starts — this clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the start-of-work payment.

> The remaining balance is due within the program's final payment days after completion, subject to the punch-list holdback — this clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the final settlement payment.

## Statuses in which payments are accepted

Payments are accepted on contracts whose status is measure booked, contracted, scheduled, in progress or completed. The status is read from the contract record.

| Contract status | Payment accepted |
|---|---|
| measure booked, contracted, scheduled, in progress, completed | yes |
| measured, closed, cancelled | no |

## Tenders and ceiling

- The tender must be one of the program's accepted tenders. A payment charged to a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account posts as a purchase on that account, and one charged to a Ridgeline Pro Credit account posts as an invoice priced on the contract price basis.
- A payment may not exceed the contract's balance due at the time it is taken.

superseded_clauses: A progress payment of progress_payment_pct percent of the contract price is due on the day work starts
and the remaining balance is due within final_payment_due_days_after_completion days after completion, subject to the punch-list holdback.
